name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
cues: Take a wide stance with your toes turned slightly out
Sit your hips back over the working leg
Keep the other leg straight and both feet flat
Drive through the working leg to bring your hips back to center

qa.note: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: This is played in place, not stepped, and cues 1-2 were rewritten to fit the animation (UK unreviewed). The hips shift 31 cm over the right foot, from a 73 cm heel span. The working knee bottoms at about 77, shallower than a typical lateral lunge (~90+), and the trailing ankle eversion sits at 29.96 of 30. It reads clearly from the front, but the owner should accept the redefinition and the shallow depth.
